steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Fold the left lower edge inward
steps.text: Bring the left corner to the centre line, a little below the middle of the sheet. Match the lower-left edge to the centre line.

steps.title: Fold the right lower edge inward
steps.text: Bring the right corner to the same spot on the centre line. The two lower edges should now meet along that line.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the top point to the bottom point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Raise the left ear
steps.text: Bring the left corner diagonally up and slightly inward. Leave a pointed ear above the straight edge.

steps.title: Raise the right ear
steps.text: Pull the right corner diagonally up and slightly inward, matching the height of the left ear.

steps.title: Soften the chin
steps.text: Fold a small bit of the bottom point up. Keep the fold shallow.

steps.title: Turn the model over
steps.text: Flip the paper left to right, keeping the top edge at the top.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the top point to the bottom point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Fold the left ear down
steps.text: Pull the left corner diagonally down to make a floppy ear.

steps.title: Fold the right ear down
steps.text: Pull the right corner diagonally down and inward. Match the height of the left ear.

steps.title: Fold up the muzzle
steps.text: Turn up a small triangle at the bottom. You can draw a nose on this flap.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the top point to the bottom point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Raise the left point
steps.text: Fold the left point sharply upward to make a tall ear.

steps.title: Raise the right point
steps.text: Mirror the left ear, leaving a space between the tips.

steps.title: Turn the model over
steps.text: Flip the paper left to right, keeping the top edge at the top.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Bring the left point to the centre
steps.text: Fold the left point to the middle of the square.

steps.title: Bring the right point to the centre
steps.text: Bring the right point in to meet the first point.

steps.title: Raise the bottom flap
steps.text: Bring the bottom point slightly above the middle, overlapping the side flaps.

steps.title: Close the top flap
steps.text: Fold the top point down over the other folds. A sticker can hold the paper envelope closed.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the bottom point to the top point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Cross the left point
steps.text: Bring the left corner to the opposite sloping edge, about a third of the way up from the base.

steps.title: Cross the right point
steps.text: Repeat in the other direction. Line up the two crossing folds.

steps.title: Lower the front rim
steps.text: Fold only the front tip down over the crossed flaps. Leave the back tip standing.

steps.title: Turn the model over
steps.text: Flip the paper left to right, keeping the top edge at the top.

steps.title: Lower the back rim
steps.text: Fold the remaining tip down on this side. Gently separate the two sides at the top to open your cup.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the bottom point to the top point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Fold a strip for the hull
steps.text: Bring the middle of the bottom edge up toward the tip, leaving most of the triangle visible as the sail.

steps.title: Turn the boat over
steps.text: Flip the boat left to right, keeping the sail pointing up. The narrow hull sits along the bottom.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Set a square of paper in front of you with a straight edge at the top.

steps.title: Shape the left side of the roof
steps.text: Bring the upper-left corner diagonally down and inward. The crease becomes the left slope of the roof.

steps.title: Shape the right side of the roof
steps.text: Bring the upper-right corner to the same spot. The two roof slopes meet at the top.

steps.title: Show the front
steps.text: Turn the paper over left to right. Add a door or windows to the flat front if you like.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Fold the left corner in
steps.text: Bring the left point to the centre.

steps.title: Fold the right corner in
steps.text: Bring the right point to the centre.

steps.title: Fold the bottom corner in
steps.text: Bring the bottom point to the centre.

steps.title: Fold the top corner in
steps.text: Bring the top point to the centre.

steps.title: Turn back the left tip
steps.text: Pull the centre tip of the left flap toward the left, stopping short of the outer edge.

steps.title: Turn back the right tip
steps.text: Pull the centre tip of the right flap toward the right.

steps.title: Turn back the lower tip
steps.text: Pull the centre tip of the lower flap toward the bottom.

steps.title: Turn back the upper tip
steps.text: Pull the last tip toward the top. Slide the corners of a small paper picture beneath the four turned-back tips.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Put a square of paper down like a diamond, with a point at the top. The lighter side starts up.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the bottom point to the top point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Raise the left point
steps.text: Fold the left corner up and inward to form one of the crown points.

steps.title: Raise the right point
steps.text: Match the fold on the right. Keep the tall centre point visible.

steps.title: Fold up the band
steps.text: Lift the middle of the bottom edge a little to give the crown a straight band.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Fold in the upper corner
steps.text: Bring the top-right corner diagonally down and left to the centre line. Keep the midpoint of the right edge fixed.

steps.title: Fold in the lower corner
steps.text: Bring the bottom-right corner to the same spot to make the arrow point.

steps.title: Narrow the top of the shaft
steps.text: At the left edge, bring the top corner down to the centre line.

steps.title: Narrow the bottom of the shaft
steps.text: Bring the bottom-left corner up to the centre line to match.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Lift the bottom edge
steps.text: Bring the lower edge straight up to make a narrow band.

steps.title: Fold the left end in
steps.text: Fold the left end toward the middle. Keep the vertical crease straight.

steps.title: Fold the right end in
steps.text: Repeat on the right so the folded ends sit beside each other.

steps.title: Close the packet
steps.text: Fold the upper edge down over the folded ends.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Fold the upper-right corner inward
steps.text: Bring the upper-right corner down to the midpoint of the bill’s height, forming the upper slope of the flag.

steps.title: Fold the lower-right corner inward
steps.text: Bring the lower-right corner up to meet the first corner. The right end now makes a point.

steps.title: Shorten the flat end
steps.text: Bring the left edge partway toward the point. Keep its crease vertical.

steps.title: Show the front
steps.text: Flip the folded pennant left to right to see the smooth side.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Fold the left third in
steps.text: Bring the left end toward the right. Keep the crease vertical.

steps.title: Fold the right end inward
steps.text: Bring the right end in to narrow the body. This will be the back when you flip it.

steps.title: Shape the upper-left roof
steps.text: Bring the upper-left corner diagonally down and right.

steps.title: Shape the upper-right roof
steps.text: Bring the upper-right corner diagonally down and left to match.

steps.title: Turn the model over
steps.text: Flip the paper left to right, keeping the top edge at the top.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Narrow the top edge
steps.text: Bring the upper edge down to the middle of the bill.

steps.title: Narrow the bottom edge
steps.text: Bring the lower edge up to meet it.

steps.title: Make the tip
steps.text: Fold the upper-right corner diagonally down to the middle.

steps.title: Finish the tip
steps.text: Fold the lower-right corner diagonally up to the same spot.

steps.title: Fold the knot end
steps.text: Bring the flat left end a short way inward to make the knot area.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Make the roof ridge
steps.text: Bring the bottom long edge to the top long edge and crease. To stand the tent on a table, lift the crease and spread the two long edges apart.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Fold up the lower edge
steps.text: Bring the lower long edge to the upper long edge to make a strip.

steps.title: Angle the left end down
steps.text: Bring the left end down and inward so it sticks below the strip.

steps.title: Angle the right end down
steps.text: Mirror the left fold. The finished shape has two downward arms.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Raise a pocket flap
steps.text: Bring the bottom edge partway up. Leave an open band above it.

steps.title: Fold the left end inward
steps.text: Bring the left end inward to narrow the pocket.

steps.title: Fold the right end inward
steps.text: Bring the right end inward to match. Slip a small paper ticket behind the raised flap.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Lay one U.S. dollar bill flat with the long edges running left to right. You can also practise with a rectangle about 2.34 times as wide as it is tall.

steps.title: Fold the lower edge up
steps.text: Bring the bottom long edge onto the top long edge.

steps.title: Raise the left end
steps.text: Fold the left end diagonally up and inward.

steps.title: Raise the right end
steps.text: Repeat the fold on the right, so both ends point up.

steps.title: Turn it over
steps.text: Flip the folded badge left to right to see the smoother face.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Start with one square sticky note, sticky side up. Keep it loose on the table so you can turn and fold it. Orient it like a diamond.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the bottom point to the top point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Lift the left petal
steps.text: Bring the left point diagonally up and toward the middle. Keep it beside the central point.

steps.title: Lift the right petal
steps.text: Bring the right point diagonally up to match the left.

steps.title: Flatten the base
steps.text: Bring the middle of the bottom edge up just a little.

steps.title: Turn the model over
steps.text: Flip the paper left to right, keeping the top edge at the top.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Start with one square sticky note, sticky side up. Keep it loose on the table so you can turn and fold it. Orient it like a diamond.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the top point to the bottom point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Lift the left wing
steps.text: Bring the left point diagonally up, leaving a wing that sticks out on that side.

steps.title: Lift the right wing
steps.text: Bring the right point diagonally up to the same height.

steps.title: Shorten the body
steps.text: Bring the bottom point partway up between the wings.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Start with one square sticky note, sticky side up. Keep it loose on the table so you can turn and fold it. Orient it like a diamond.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.text: Bring the top point to the bottom point. Press along the horizontal fold.

steps.title: Fold the front tip up
steps.text: Bring only the front bottom point to the middle of the long top edge. Leave the back layer down.

steps.title: Close the left side
steps.text: Fold the left point inward across the front flap.

steps.title: Close the right side
steps.text: Fold the right point inward to match. Slip a page corner between the front flap and the back layer.

steps.title: Set out your paper
steps.text: Start with one square sticky note, sticky side up. Keep it loose on the table so you can turn and fold it. Orient it like a diamond.

steps.title: Fold the left point in
steps.text: Bring the left point to the centre of the note.

steps.title: Fold the right point in
steps.text: Bring the right point to the same spot.

steps.title: Raise the bottom flap
steps.text: Bring the bottom point a little past the centre.

steps.title: Close the top flap
steps.text: Fold the top point down over the other folds.
